subject: crashes when fitting various SPDEs in a model

messages.author: ef76f4ec1ca10943
messages.subject: crashes when fitting various SPDEs in a model
parts:
Hello,

I am having some problems when fitting a SPDE model. I have 12 years of data, with a range of 50 to 70 observations per year in a rather big spatial area. My problematic model goes like this:

Y_i = int + covar1 + covar2 + 12*latent fields (one per year)

this model would give the error:

repeated few times for different Eigenvalues:

    *** WARNING *** Eigenvalue 13 of the Hessian is -1.22218 < 0
    *** WARNING *** Set this eigenvalue to 0.548927
    *** WARNING *** This have consequence for the accurancy of
    *** WARNING *** the approximations; please check!!!
    *** WARNING *** R-inla: Use option inla(..., control.inla = list(h = h.value), ...)
    *** WARNING *** R-inla: to chose a different  `h.value'.'

and finally:

Killed
Error en inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed()


So based on what I´ve read in previous discussions I used a cascade of models using "...diagonal=X" & "...restart=TRUE), from 10e6 to 0. Using this, I still get the first error in some of the steps but it apparently successes to do the calculations.

Nevertheless, in the very last moment, when passing from the "diagonal=1" to the real model it crashes again.

Do you know what can be causing the problem? shall I change the H.value? if so, how should I do this, based on what?

Many thanks,
Iosu

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] crashes when fitting various SPDEs in a model
parts:
On 01/04/14 09:10, ipampa wrote:
> Y_i = int + covar1 + covar2 + 12*latent fields (one per year)

Hi, I'm not sure this affect the crashing, but how precisely have you
defined the latent fields? As 12 separate f() models (with their own
parameters) or as a single one (with one set of parameters) but with
12 replicates?

Finn
